about.heading: Fountainhead School Malgama
about.intro: Fountainhead School Malgama (FSM) is the newest addition to the Fountainhead Schools group — bringing the same outstanding IB education that Surat knows and trusts, to a brand new campus location. Offering Early Years and the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP), FSM will be a warm, vibrant, and modern learning environment for children aged 3 to 11. Ground breaking has been completed — FSM is on its way.
about.milestoneBody: The official Ground Breaking Ceremony for FSM has been completed, marking the beginning of construction on the new campus.
about.leadershipHeading: Built on the FS Learning Model

learningPillars.title: Learner Agency
learningPillars.body: Children are active agents of their own learning — with genuine choice, voice, and ownership from the very first day.

learningPillars.title: Inquiry-Based Learning
learningPillars.body: Every activity is designed to provoke curiosity and encourage exploration. Questions are celebrated more than answers.

learningPillars.title: Social-Emotional Wellbeing
learningPillars.body: We develop emotional vocabulary and resilience alongside academic skills — the whole child, every day.

learningPillars.title: Environment as Third Teacher
learningPillars.body: Spaces are designed intentionally — natural elements, inviting materials, and displays that extend children's thinking.

academics.heading: Learning at FSM

programmes.title: Early Years Programme
programmes.body: Play-based inquiry rooted in the IB PYP framework. Learner agency, social-emotional resilience, the environment as the third teacher. Every child is seen, heard, and celebrated.

programmes.title: Primary Years Programme (PYP)
programmes.body: Six transdisciplinary units of inquiry per year. Collaborative, concept-driven learning developing the whole child and the IB learner profile through authentic, meaningful experiences.

academics.learningModelHeading: The FS Learning Model at FSM
academics.learningModelText1: FSM is built on the same pedagogical foundation as FSK — the flagship. Students are at the centre of everything we do. We place a strong emphasis on fostering a love of learning, building academic competencies alongside physical fitness, creativity, and social-emotional wellbeing.
transdisciplinaryThemes: Where We Are in Place & Time

admissions.heading: Join FSM
admissions.subheading: Our PAE process — three steps. Transparent, fair, centred on the child.

steps.title: Pre-Admission
steps.body: Reach out to our admissions team to register your interest and receive updates about FSM's opening timeline. Visit the site or connect with us online.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: Age-appropriate interaction to understand your child — warm, play-based, and focused on curiosity rather than academic performance.

steps.title: Enrolment
steps.body: Welcome to the FSM family — documentation, orientation, and your child's exciting beginning at Fountainhead.

docsRequired: Last two years' academic report cards
